** Multi-region VPN solution for 2-5 branch offices

**Architecture Overview:**
- Hub-and-spoke design with AWS as the central hub
- Two AWS regions for redundancy (us-east-1 and us-west-2)
- Each branch office connects to nearest region
- Medium bandwidth (100-500 Mbps) per connection
- Offices access AWS resources only (no inter-office communication)
